title: The Iron Maiden
text: An iron coffin stands open on a hill, its inside lined with spikes, rust running from their points like old blood. A warm, coaxing voice within promises strength to whoever steps in: strength like iron, it says, that never breaks.

options.label: The weakest steps in to be made strong, desperate enough to trust the voice.

outcomes.text: The spikes close but do not quite meet. They step out harder than before, bleeding from a dozen holes.

options.label: The most battle-scarred knows the trick: wedge the lid, then pry out the iron.

outcomes.text: They wedge the lid with a scabbard and pry out the spikes. The voice inside goes very quiet.

options.label: Close the lid and walk on; no strength is worth that embrace.

outcomes.text: The voice keeps calling through the iron all afternoon, warm and patient.
